text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
The signboard that Carmina's producer gifted to us
really leaves quite the impression, doesn't it?
None of the guests have mentioned it though...
choice_data_list: I wanna put my face in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カルミナのプロデューサーさんが贈ってくれた
立て看板、
すごいインパクトよね。
お客さん、
誰もアレについて触れてないけど……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
We didn't tell her we had turned it into a business, so I wonder how
she found out. She sent us lots of other promo tools as well, so we
should really thank her. Next time we see her, let's show our gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
温泉を始める、
なんて
言ってないのにね。
どこで知ったのかしら。
他にも
宣伝道具くれたりしたから
感謝しないといけないわよね。
今度会ったら
きちんとお礼しましょう。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
All those kids who were playing with the sign earlier were super cute,
weren't they? I want to have fun with them too.
But I might get mistaken for a cow again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの立て看板で遊んでる子どもたち、
かわいかったわね。
私も一緒に遊びたいわ。
また
牛と間違われちゃいそうだけど……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did she really want to name a hot spring on a ranch [i]that[/i]?
Yeah, it's a fine name, but it doesn't really fit the bucolic
mood of Elizabeth Park. It's perfect for Producer though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　牧場温泉を
そんな名前にしたがってたの？
いい名前だと思うけど、
牧場の雰囲気とは合わないわよね。
あのプロデューサーさんにはぴったりだけど。
